changes: Include ordinary animated tavern patrons in Cherry's audience during automatic nightly and requested performances. Use their native walk frames with gentle facing changes, without moving their floor positions or starting combat.

Return audience members to their previous facing and idle state when the show ends; pause during dialogue and resume afterward, including when an old speaker reference remains. Furniture, letters, doors, hostile actors, dead NPCs and Cherry are excluded from the audience controller.

Replace black or near-black natural ground in Gibraltar, British lowlands and other western regions with grass, heath, scrub, woodland and dry-earth colours. Preserve buildings, road paving, snow caps, river channels and the forest guild layout.
Give Ger's rough-rock tiles a local sandstone/limestone palette in the world and atlas, resetting the override when changing maps.
Remove the v98 mainland fill around Mediterranean islands; restore Corsica/Sardinia and the Aegean islands as separated landforms, and pull the African coast south around the southern basin.
Keep existing local actor/quest/ferry coordinates and signed land crossings, while restoring sea travel between islands. Shared chart edges and the matching server geometry/resources are updated.

Recover player saves displaced by the new shore with a migration receipt. Allow persisted Suncat positions displaced far from the corrected shore to recover to nearby clear ground on the same map, without using an online player as the anchor.

configuration.secrets: Use hosting environment variables only; no credential values are included.

configuration.model: SUNCAT_MODEL changes the default brain model. SUNCAT_CHARACTER_MODEL, SUNCAT_GM_MODEL, SUNCAT_UTILITY_MODEL and SUNCAT_MODERATION_MODEL override their conversation roles.
configuration.accounting: SUNCAT_AI_INPUT_PER_MILLION and SUNCAT_AI_OUTPUT_PER_MILLION set cost estimates; this is not a provider billing cap.
configuration.deployment: Use the matching v99 client and server 1.10.42. Files only. Preserve existing memory/account files and environment credentials.
configuration.relicCustody: One of each Hallow per saved personal story world, with a browser custody anchor and a copy inside the character save. Different offline worlds are independent; this is not global multiplayer trade authority.

limitations: The atlas is a compressed fantasy geography retaining authored locations; it is not a scale-accurate or prehistoric coastline reconstruction.
Kypros, Rhodos and Thera again require the existing sea-crossing mechanics after removal of the accidental v98 land connections. Suncat's existing independent swimming/sailing limits remain.

Cherry's song audio, requested-song choices, night default, stage choreography and spotlight retain v98 behaviour. The audience uses each character's existing native movement frames rather than new dance meshes.
Local browser and mocked-server checks passed. Live song delivery, Gemini/Render traffic and Samsung S9 performance have not been tested.
Early Indian and Chinese cultural chapters, cultivation, vampire-Cherry continuation and zoom-dependent macro-region labels remain deferred.

Update eight former sea-chart labels where their redrawn terrain is mainland or coast. Matching current names, atlas positions and physical terrain are included in the server.
Recover old saves stranded by shoreline changes to nearby clear ground, retaining quest progress and historical journals. Preserve the new coastline through both Savage Forest guild layouts.

Play Cherry's native sprite frames at 150 ms instead of 400 ms during the tavern show; add bounded caches of her existing walk and kick poses with her custom colours.
Use smooth 24-second stage phrases, broad movement and planted kick turns; no skeleton, limb animation or song-audio changes.
Add a soft follow spotlight in the perspective renderer, clipped against world depth, with no accumulating particles or extra NPCs.
